recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-9719 follow-up is needed in core; related Composition $document issues are already represented on the combined branch or were handled by later source history.
issue_request: FHIR-9719 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for the DSTU2 Composition $document operation. It asked for a POST example, an instance-level GET form such as GET [base]/Composition/id/$document, a missing slash before $document in the example URL, and clarification that the GET request generates a document rather than retrieves one. The resolution recorded that items 2, 3, and 4 were already done and that a POST example would be created.
initial_application: Commit 85fb5d07b468bc9a37e357e86a039c60d0520b66, imported from svn revision 13106 and labeled GF#9719, added a POST request example to source/composition/$document-request.txt. At that time the POST example used the then-current type-level Composition/$document form plus an id parameter.
additional_context: Composition is active in source/fhir.ini and source/composition/list-Composition-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/Composition-document, making the OperationDefinition and its request example current build inputs. Later FHIR-13987/FHIR-19974 context established that $document requires a target Composition, and commit 7f9f6257cc05849685341f1e521e5fe616032d56 removed the type-level variant and id parameter while preserving the POST example on the instance URL. Current source has GET and POST examples on /Composition/{id}/$document, references the request example from the OperationDefinition, marks the operation instance=true/type=false/system=false, and has affectsState=false so the GET form is permitted by generic operation rules. Zulip discussion and existing FHIR-19974/FHIR-13987 reconciliation commits support the later instance-only interpretation.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active source already satisfies FHIR-9719's remaining POST-example request without reintroducing the obsolete type-level id-parameter form, and local searches found no stale [base]/Composition/$document or id-parameter operation definition text under source/composition.
